## Purpose

This worked example instantiates the Environment Recovery and Support Exception Procedure for a local experimental environment under laptop resource pressure.

## Exception Record

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Exception ID | `ENV-EXC-2026-07-27-001` |
| Environment Profile | Local MacBook-hosted experimental Wiki.JS stack |
| Trigger | Docker-hosted wiki instability during documentation publication work |
| Baseline Divergence | Temporary inability to treat the local wiki stack as continuously available |
| Approval Posture | Accepted as a bounded experimental-environment exception |
| Recovery Action | Manual restart of the Wiki.js stack and post-restart MCP verification |
| Closure State | Recovered |

## Interpretation

This example shows how local experimental environments may temporarily deviate from ideal support posture without invalidating the broader controlled-documentation workflow.
